---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea for GramCash
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of what problem this feature would solve. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Alternative Solutions
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## User Benefit
How would this feature help GramCash users, particularly those in rural and low-digital-literacy contexts?

## Technical Considerations
Any technical thoughts or constraints to consider.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## Priority
- [ ] Critical (Essential for user success)
- [ ] High (Significantly improves user experience)
- [ ] Medium (Nice to have)
- [ ] Low (Future enhancement)

## Target Users
- [ ] First-time smartphone users
- [ ] Low-digital-literacy users
- [ ] Rural population
- [ ] Semi-urban population
- [ ] All users
